Name: Fully Functional Mine Elevator (Start at Level 120)
Author: JaneElliot
Description:
I used to love mining in Stardew Valley, but after 100 new farms (and grinding the mines 100 times), I'm ready to just jump right into Skull Cavern.  This mod allows you to do just that, by giving you access to all of the vanilla mine stops from the moment you start the game.

[size=5][b]IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ[/b][/size][list]
[*][b]You still need to stop at levels 5 and 40 (in that order) to complete the mining quests and to progress the Adventurer's Guild storyline.[/b]
[*]You don't have to [i]do[/i] anything on those levels, just use the elevator to access them.
[*]You will still need to kill 10 slimes to access the Adventurer's Guild building.
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]:
[list]
[*]Should work with everything. Please let me know if you find any conflicts.
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]:
[list]
[*]Requires SMAPI
[*]Unzip the file and copy to your Mods folder
[/list]
[b]Thank you to the Stardew Valley Discord [/b](who did all of the actual coding on this mod :)
